title: Glass damage
text: Comprehensive motor cover pays for repair or replacement of broken windscreens, side and rear windows. The excess for glass damage is EUR 150; it is waived if the windscreen is repaired instead of replaced.

title: Wildlife collision
text: Comprehensive motor cover pays for damage caused by a collision with animals of any kind. The policyholder must report the collision to the police or the forest authority within 24 hours.

title: Theft of the vehicle
text: Comprehensive motor cover pays the replacement value of a stolen vehicle if it is not found within one month after the theft was reported to the police. Keys must be handed over to the insurer.

title: Rental car after an accident
text: After an insured accident the insurer pays a rental car of the same vehicle class for up to 14 days, at most EUR 60 per day, while the insured vehicle is being repaired.

title: No-claims discount
text: Each claim-free year moves the policy one class up in the no-claims scale. A paid liability claim moves it down by three classes. Glass claims do not affect the no-claims class.

title: Driving abroad
text: Motor cover applies in all countries of the European Economic Area and in Switzerland. For other countries an international insurance card must be requested before travel.

title: Water damage
text: Home contents cover pays for damage caused by water escaping from pipes, heating systems and household appliances. Damage from rising groundwater is not covered.

title: Storm and hail
text: Buildings cover pays for damage from storm with wind force 8 or more and from hail. Damage to awnings is covered only if they were retracted during the storm.

title: Burglary
text: Home contents cover pays for items stolen in a burglary. Cash is covered up to EUR 1,500 and jewellery up to EUR 20,000 if it was kept in a locked safe.

title: Bicycle theft
text: Bicycles are covered against theft up to 1 percent of the sum insured if they were locked to a fixed object. Theft between 22:00 and 06:00 is covered only from a locked room.

title: Hotel costs
text: If the home cannot be lived in after an insured event, the insurer pays hotel costs for up to 100 days, at most EUR 120 per day.

title: Reporting deadline
text: Every claim must be reported within 7 days after the policyholder learns of it. Theft and burglary must also be reported to the police without delay.

title: Required documents
text: A claim needs the policy number, a description of the event, photos of the damage and, where available, invoices or a cost estimate. Theft claims need the police report number.

title: Payment period
text: The insurer pays within 14 days after the amount of the claim has been determined. An advance payment can be requested one month after the claim was reported.

title: Online claim status
text: Policyholders can see the status of a claim in the customer portal under 'My claims'. The status shows received, in assessment, approved or paid.
